title: populus × canadensis var. erecta
intro: Populus × canadensis var. erecta, commonly known as hybrid black cottonwood or California black cottonwood, is a deciduous tree species in the willow family (Salicaceae). This plant is known for its therapeutic properties, particularly in treating various health issues, including inflammation, pain, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Populus × canadensis var. erecta include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and act as an expectorant to relieve respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and salicin, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antiseptic properties.
